issues.description: The REST controller method getAllPersons() has different visibility in the template and the solution: the template declares it as public while the solution declares it as private. This inconsistency is structural and may confuse students about the required visibility of controller handler methods (and about why the solution behaves differently).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent and follow Spring MVC conventions: declare the controller handler method getAllPersons() as public in both the template and solution (update the solution to use public), so students are not confused about required visibility for REST endpoint methods.
